messages.content: Person: Alice Chen, lead engineer at Acme. Project: pegasus-rewrite, the customer-facing rewrite. System: pegasus-api, the public HTTP service. Alice owns pegasus-rewrite.
Noted. Alice Chen leads pegasus-rewrite which produces pegasus-api.
Project: orion-dashboard, internal analytics tool built on top of pegasus-api. System: orion-frontend, the Vue 3 SPA. Concept: row-level-security, a data-isolation pattern we enforce everywhere.
Person: Bob Martinez, devops on call this week. System: postgres-primary, the main relational store. Bob owns postgres-primary maintenance.
Lesson: never-deploy-friday, we had a bad incident in March and now block Friday deploys. Event: 2024-03-15-outage, the four-hour pegasus-api outage caused by a Friday push.
Project: nimbus-migration, moving orion-dashboard off legacy storage. System: object-store-s3, the new blob backend. Concept: blue-green-deploy, the rollout strategy we picked for nimbus-migration.
Person: Carol Singh, security lead. Concept: zero-trust-network, perimeter model Carol champions. Carol owns zero-trust-network rollout.
System: redis-cache, in-memory cache fronting pegasus-api. System: kafka-bus, the event backbone. Concept: event-sourcing, the pattern kafka-bus enables.
Lesson: always-feature-flag, after the orion-dashboard rollback we ship behind flags. Person: Dave Park, frontend engineer on orion-frontend.
